mapper.insert: insert into agent_task(task_id,run_id,turn_id,session_id,user_id,task_type,status,progress,current_stage, request_json,answer,citations_json,attempt_count,next_retry_at,lease_owner,lease_until,error_code,error_message, created_at,updated_at,started_at,finished_at) values(#{taskId},#{runId},#{turnId},#{sessionId},#{userId},#{taskType},#{status},#{progress},#{currentStage}, #{requestJson},#{answer},#{citationsJson},#{attemptCount},#{nextRetryAt},#{leaseOwner},#{leaseUntil},#{errorCode},#{errorMessage}, #{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{startedAt},#{finishedAt}) on duplicate key update status=values(status),progress=values(progress),current_stage=values(current_stage), answer=values(answer),citations_json=values(citations_json),attempt_count=values(attempt_count), next_retry_at=values(next_retry_at),lease_owner=values(lease_owner),lease_until=values(lease_until), error_code=values(error_code),error_message=values(error_message),updated_at=values(updated_at), started_at=values(started_at),finished_at=values(finished_at)
mapper.select: select * from agent_task where session_id=#{sessionId} order by created_at asc
select * from agent_task where (status='PENDING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (status='RUNNING' and lease_until < #{now}) order by created_at asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update agent_task set status='RUNNING', lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, started_at=coalesce(started_at,#{now}), updated_at=#{now} where task_id=#{taskId} and ((status='PENDING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (status='RUNNING' and lease_until < #{now}))

update agent_task set status=#{record.status}, progress=#{record.progress}, current_stage=#{record.currentStage}, answer=#{record.answer}, citations_json=#{record.citationsJson}, next_retry_at=#{record.nextRetryAt}, lease_owner=#{record.leaseOwner}, lease_until=#{record.leaseUntil}, error_code=#{record.errorCode}, error_message=#{record.errorMessage}, updated_at=#{record.updatedAt}, finished_at=#{record.finishedAt} where task_id=#{record.taskId} and status='RUNNING' and lease_owner=#{expectedLeaseOwner}

update agent_task set status='CANCELLED', progress=100, current_stage='CANCELLED', answer='任务已取消。', citations_json='[]', next_retry_at=null, lease_owner=null, lease_until=null, error_code='TASK_CANCELLED', error_message='任务已取消。', updated_at=#{now}, finished_at=#{now} where task_id=#{taskId} and user_id=#{userId} and status in ('PENDING','RUNNING')
